title: Run the root-delta scale phase at 500 steps with 1000 on demand
outcome: Greg decided (2026-09-27 about 03:20Z, via Engram::Fable) to try the gate's root-delta scale phase at 500 steps: its waiver-history build is quadratic and takes 415 of the gate's 749 s at 1000. 1000 stays available on demand.
acceptance: At the size it runs, each scale test still distinguishes growth that is linear in history from growth that is quadratic; the write-bytes test checks this itself by asserting that a full-root copy at that size would exceed each write budget.
The scale phase and the full gate at 500 are measured on the same host and compared with the baseline full gate test-67c5626f (749.0 s, scale phase 428.5 s).

The three root_delta_scale_ tests run their long fixtures at 500 steps by default, and an environment variable selects another size (1000 on demand); an unset variable means 500, and a value that is not a positive integer fails the test and names the variable.
docs/development.md and docs/features/sqlite-store.md describe the default size and how to run 1000.

completion.summary: Landed as 30ebfaf. The three root_delta_scale_ tests build 500 steps by default. ENGRAM_ROOT_DELTA_SCALE selects a size from 500 to 1000; any other value fails the test, naming the variable and the limit. Each test prints the size it built and its source. The write-bytes scale test asserts that a full-root copy at its size would exceed both write budgets. The waiver test runs 100 and the chosen size. Measured on this host: the scale phase took 114.19 s (428.49 s at 1000), and the full gate 304.0 s against the 749.0 s baseline (test-67c5626f; the baseline compiled cold). Docs updated: development.md, sqlite-store.md and local-work-system.md. Two review rounds; round 2 was clean from Codex and Claude. Readiness was ready on both live stores; build cb628fb668de is installed. Independent evaluation delegation-5e3022b9 passed all four criteria.
